necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. This advanced monitoring is required to evaluate the etiology of the syncope (R55) given the patient's complex cardiac history.
